big_pour.headline: Pennsylvania requires labels on AI-generated ads
big_pour.summary: Pennsylvania passed a law requiring any advertisement that is significantly modified or generated by artificial intelligence to clearly display a label. The rule covers still images, video, audio, and text.
big_pour.why: You will soon see clear labels disclosing when political or commercial advertisements use artificial intelligence.

big_pour.headline: OpenAI stops training models on live internet
big_pour.summary: OpenAI will no longer train its frontier artificial intelligence models on the live internet, pointing to "significant risks" as the reason for cutting them off.

big_pour.headline: Grok and OpenAI split on political candidates
big_pour.summary: A new study found Grok's AI overwhelmingly recommends Republican candidates while OpenAI's GPT favors Democrats. The two models disagreed in more than 90% of nearly 500 election races.

office_blend.headline: Bayer Crop Science builds natural language decision engine
office_blend.summary: Bayer Crop Science built a multi-agent platform on Amazon Bedrock AgentCore that lets breeders, analysts, and researchers ask natural language questions about their analytics platform.

office_blend.headline: SAP updates certification renewals with AI roleplays
office_blend.summary: SAP now lets professionals renew their credentials using artificial intelligence roleplays, shifting assessments away from memorizing facts toward applying skills to real situations.

still_roasting.summary: Claude Duet is currently only available through a waitlist for Pro and Max plan subscribers.
Nirva will ship its $249 ambient listening pendant by the end of the year.

quick_sips.summary: Google updated its privacy policy to allow Gmail data to be used for ad targeting if Personal Intelligence is enabled.
Microduck voice-controlled toy robots sold 20,000 units after the Nvidia CEO was seen playing with them.
IskayPet built a multilingual assistant to answer employee questions across retail, procurement, and veterinary care in three countries.

stories.label: Open source stack
stories.headline: Google open-sources native PyTorch stack for TPUs
stories.summary: Google released TorchTPU, an open-source tool that allows developers to run PyTorch workloads directly on Google TPUs.

stories.label: Open standard
stories.headline: OpenAI donates common model API specification
stories.summary: OpenAI donated its Open Responses API specification to the open-source Agentic AI Foundation to support a common standard.

concept.explanation: A shared blueprint that defines how different software programs communicate. It appeared when OpenAI donated its Open Responses design to an open-source foundation to standardize interactions between AI systems.

long_read.headline: What’s the ROI of software engineers’ spending on AI?
long_read.summary: The newsletter examines data from 27 companies to evaluate whether rising spending on artificial intelligence actually improves software shipping velocity and code output.

sign_off: That's the last sip. See you next morning.

word.definition: A large language model, an AI trained on huge amounts of text to predict and write words.
word.analogy: Like a barista who has read every coffee menu in the world and can describe any drink you name.

keep_brewing.name: Elements of AI
keep_brewing.description: A free beginner course, no coding or maths needed. One short chapter with your morning coffee.

poll.question: Would you let an AI book your next trip?
